bear_assumptions: USD 23 normalized forward EPS at 22x as government or industrial demand slows, tariff refunds fade, mix reverses, supply constraints rise, or acquisition and fixed-price execution weaken margins and cash conversion.
base_assumptions: USD 27 normalized forward EPS at 25x as backlog converts, organic growth moderates, margins and cash generation remain strong, and debt reduction broadly offsets acquisition risk.
bull_assumptions: USD 30 normalized forward EPS at 29x as defense, space, unmanned, infrared and marine demand sustain above-trend organic growth while mix, integration, deleveraging and cash conversion support a premium.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade if a fresh mark clears expected-return, base-upside, payoff and margin-of-safety gates while organic growth, backlog conversion, margins, free cash flow, leverage and acquisition discipline remain sound and a current accepted relationship exists; downgrade if organic growth stalls, backlog fails to convert, margins or free cash flow deteriorate, fixed-price losses or supply constraints rise, acquisitions impair per-share returns, leverage increases materially, or guidance falls.
